name: visual-lexicon-manuscript-ceiling-gate-zero
purpose: Determine whether the Visual Lexicon can possibly supply the preregistered minimum number of manuscript-level independent components before any record crawl, image acquisition, label adjudication or model inference.

council.decision: Visual Lexicon metadata first; local Tlachia archives are exclusion/collision evidence only; require at least 42 manuscript components and 10 active classes before image acquisition.

bounded_discovery_log.purpose: Confirm the official catalogue route, HTML field names, pagination shape and manuscript taxonomy select before implementing the auditor.
bounded_discovery_log.note: This iteration is a deterministic verification and decision audit of an acquisition ceiling, not a blind model-efficacy experiment.

single_factor.name: external instrument source feasibility under conservative manuscript exclusion
single_factor.source: Visual Lexicon of Aztec Hieroglyphs official manuscript taxonomy
single_factor.changed_from_v11: availability of a newly sourced independent evaluation instrument

component_definition.unit: Visual Lexicon source manuscript taxonomy term
component_definition.unlisted_terms: provisionally external only; later image collision audit would still be mandatory

short_circuit_rule: If the strict manuscript-component ceiling is below 42, stop immediately with instrument_not_acquired. Do not crawl record detail pages, inspect labels or rights, download images, run either model, recalculate thresholds downward or consume the one-shot evaluation.

conditional_next_phase_only_if_pass.strict_label_mapping: exact normalized runtime class only; ambiguities rejected and double-reviewed
conditional_next_phase_only_if_pass.rights: report with and without NC, but exclude NC/unknown from strict admission absent explicit compatibility
conditional_next_phase_only_if_pass.collision_checks: byte, decoded RGB and quasi-duplicate checks against v8, consumed v4/v5 and decoded local archives
conditional_next_phase_only_if_pass.one_shot_scope: covered classes only, frozen before prediction
